settings.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
settings.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
settings.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
settings.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
settings.comparison: same selected peer is explicit in both joint and departure-only calculations
settings.transfer: one fixed half incremental correction through current v77 constraints
settings.common_error: one shared15-second mean perturbation across the selected two cohorts
settings.scope: existing ambiguous Rome gap gate, original monthly quality gate, supported sources
settings.peer_selection: maximum trace(inv(target leave-one-out covariance) times projected peer covariance)
settings.peer_support: all retained discrete values and weights for the selected long flight
settings.tie_break: smallest movement ID after rounding standardized variance shares to12 decimals
settings.control: exact v78; candidate replays v77 with the new fixed half increment

design.change: one largest-variance long peer retains its full discrete support in each target message
design.primary: replay v77 plus0.5 times refined joint-minus-departure increment versus exact v78
design.retained: same source calibration, priors, source memberships, scope, weight and final constraints
design.limitation: one explicit peer; all remaining peer moments remain approximate; reused development data
